title: librarian-chat-surface
intention: The CHAT FACE — the conversational surface over the loop and the transducer (cairn/devices/librarian/chat.py), the LAST stone of the ratified chain: the librarian is now a chatbot. The face adds NO third mechanism: LEARNING ALWAYS is every turn crossing the core loop (the reply is the graph's WALK, never the generate text; a miss backfills and the original question resubmits through structure), and SUMMARIZING WHEN ASKED is the `summarize:` prefix routing to the transducer. THE ROUTE IS PHYSICS, NOT A GUESSED INTENT: a stated affordance, matched deterministically, zero inference spent classifying the utterance. A verb's loud refusal becomes a legible REPLY the session survives. The transcript is runtime state and dies with the process; the graph is the memory that survives it — which is what makes follow-ups immediate across sessions, not just across turns. THE CARRIER (corrected 2026-07-28): there is ONLY EVER ONE WEB SERVER in the system — the librarian owns a PAGE the extant web server displays. Its chat window is a surface the base shim class understands: LibrarianDevice DECLARES the chat pane (cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py's LibrarianShim rides the roster, wakes the device on the first poke and attaches the live face), and a POSTed utterance travels web_server → shim.deliver → device.receive. No chat route, no injected chat source, no second door; the web listener (listener.py, renamed from daemon.py) acts only on external calls — NO DAEMONS.
why: Akien's first-face ruling, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'we can also ask deeper questions from [the summary]... And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' The go for this stone: 'The word is given. Warp speed.' The carrier was CC's read on the parent ticket ('web_server exists and can carry it — unratified') and the go ratified it: web_server's own charter said its why was 'the librarian needs a web interface, and a web interface falls out of the chatbot only if the surface exists first' — this stone is that sentence coming true. The route-as-physics choice traces Akien's standing frame: an intent guess is an unmeasured hypothesis steering a real host call (Law 3), and the prefix affordance is SAID on the surface so nobody memorizes it (build-to-the-tool).
traces_to: Law 1 — a warm turn spends NOTHING: no generate for the answer (the walk is the reply), none for routing (the prefix is physics); the same question in a later turn is a walk, zero backfills — the chat's memory is the graph, chat teeth pin all three
Law 3 — every reply carries its measurements: the verdict shows best-vs-floor, the summary shows reached-vs-exists; the surface renders them, never rounds them away

Law 6 — the surface owns nothing: the transcript is the session's, the knowledge is the tree's (librarian-owned, db_domain-gated), the web_server only carries; chat.py's import allowlist is loop + summarize + trees — the face composes, it opens no door

Law 7 — a refusal is a reply the session survives (raw carried whole by the verb, rendered loudly); a dying turn is a legible 500 whose breadcrumb records the 500 the page collapsed; every librarian string is escaped at the surface

Law 8 — a chatbot wearing a librarian's charter (the parent's named wrong-shape: answers from inference, not structure) cannot pass the teeth: the reply IS the walk, and the proof asserts the generate text never surfaces

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_chat.py (12 teeth — the verb + the declared pane + mail routing + the shim's wake) + cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_web_server_chat.py (6 teeth, the pane carried through the STANDARD machinery: real LibrarianShim on a real ground loop, fake face injected) + test_web_server.py re-sealed, all under the tester's MEASURED netns seal. Live gate at LEARNME: the listener up, a real conversation at /device/librarian over the library tree, reported honestly whichever way it lands.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a turn spending inference on routing (the prefix is the physics); a reply carrying the generate text instead of the walk; a refused turn killing the session or vanishing silently; the surface accreting transcript or knowledge of its own; a librarian string reaching the page as live markup; an unwired chat pretending (it must 404 loudly, no nav entry). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: humans not finding the summarize: affordance in live use — the fix is surface wording first, intent inference LAST (charter edge h).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when live conversations accumulate (does one-utterance-one-question hold, or does the core-loop's edge (d) decomposition get pulled?), when a persistent conversation needs an instance-space berth, or when the multi-day research face (the assignment/desk) arrives to drive the session proactively.
